verdict.rationale: Asana Rules (trigger-and-action automation) are explicitly referenced (rule actions, app components on rules, PagerDuty/Rules integration) and extended by webhooks, API, and third-party no-code tools like Zapier/n8n that build trigger-action automations against Asana, directly matching the engineer's story of eliminating repetitive manual steps. Missing for 10: no first-party in-depth documentation of the Rules builder UI itself or independent hands-on review confirming rule reliability at scale.
